originalTitle: 'I don't even know if my parents are alive' - the war heroes jailed 25 years ago
title: Kids Want Answers: Missing Moms and Dads for 25 Years!
content:
Hello, My Friends Across Africa!

Hi everyone! I'm your friendly news reporter, here to share an important story with you today. It's a story about families, about children, and about hoping for answers. It's a story from our big, beautiful continent of Africa. We are going to talk about some kids who are very brave and very strong. Imagine not seeing your mommy or your daddy for a very, very long time. Imagine you want to give them a hug, but you don't know where they are. That's what this story is about. It's about children who miss their parents so much.

A Very, Very Long Time

These children have not seen their parents for 25 whole years. Can you imagine how long 25 years is? If you are in Class 2, you might be 7 or 8 years old. So, 25 years is even longer than you have been alive! It's longer than your older brother or sister has been alive, maybe even longer than your parents have been together! It feels like a very, very long time. For these kids, some of them were just tiny babies when their parents went away. Some of them were not even born yet! They have grown up without their moms and dads by their side. They have missed so many birthdays and special days with them. Did you know? If you are 7 years old, 25 years is like waiting for your birthday almost four times over, and then some! It’s a really, really, really long time to wait for someone you love.

Who Are These Parents?

These missing parents were very important people. They were what we call 'politicians'. A politician is a person who helps run a country. They make big decisions that help everyone live better. They work to make schools, hospitals, and roads good for all the people. These politicians were helping their country. They were working for the people. But then, something sad happened. They were taken away from their homes and families.

Where Did They Go?

These important parents were put in a place called 'jail'. Jail is usually where people go if they do something wrong. But for these parents, nobody really knows why they were taken. And nobody knows where exactly they went. It's a big mystery. This happened in a country called Eritrea. Eritrea is a country in Africa. It's a beautiful country, just like many others in our big continent. It has mountains and deserts and a lovely coastline. It has many kind people who live there. Did you know? Eritrea is in East Africa! It is next to countries like Sudan and Ethiopia. If you look at a map of Africa, you can find it near the Red Sea. It’s a very special place.

Sad Hearts and Big Questions

Imagine how sad the children must feel. They have grown up without their parents. They have so many questions. They ask, 'Where are our mommies and daddies?' They ask, 'Are they safe?' They ask, 'Are they happy?' One of the children said something very, very sad. He said, "I don't even know if my parents are alive." Imagine saying that about your own mommy or daddy. It means he doesn't know if his parents are still living or if they have passed away. This is a very hard thing for any child to think about. These children have spent their whole lives wondering. They wonder what their parents look like now. They wonder if they will ever get to hug them again. Their hearts carry a lot of worry and sadness.

What Do the Children Want?

So, what do these children want after all these years? They want answers. They want to know the truth. They want someone to tell them what happened to their parents. They want to know where they are. They want to know if they are safe. They also want to understand why this happened. Why were their parents taken away? Why have they not been allowed to see them for so long? These are fair questions that any child would ask. They deserve to know. They are asking the people in charge of the country to help them. They are asking for someone to tell them the news, good or bad. Just knowing would help their hearts feel a little bit better.

Everyone Deserves to Know

It is important for everyone to know where their family is. This is a special rule called a 'human right'. Human rights are like very important rules that make sure everyone is treated fairly and kindly. One of these rules is that families should be together, and if someone is taken away, their family should know where they are and why. These children are not asking for money or toys. They are asking for a very basic thing: to know about their parents. It is a right that every single child in the world should have. It helps them to feel safe and loved, even when things are very hard. Did you know? There are special groups around the world that try to help families like this. They work hard to make sure everyone's human rights are respected. They try to speak up for people who cannot speak for themselves.

Hope for the Future

Even though this is a sad story, there is always hope. These children are very brave to speak out. They are asking for help, and many people are listening. People all around Africa and the whole world care about them. They hope that one day, soon, they will get the answers they have waited for. They hope that maybe, just maybe, they will get to see their parents again. Or, if not, they hope to at least know what happened, so their hearts can have some peace. Remember, it is good to care about others. When we hear stories like this, it reminds us to be kind and to always hope for good things for everyone. Let's send our kind thoughts to these brave children in Eritrea, hoping they find their answers soon. Thank you for listening!
summary: Children in Eritrea are bravely asking for answers about their politician parents who were jailed 25 years ago without a trace, hoping to know if they are alive and where they are.
whyMatters: It matters because every child deserves to know where their parents are and to feel safe, and it's important that people speak up for those who cannot get answers about their missing family.

originalTitle: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
title: Grown-Ups Want Everyone Safe in Sunny South Africa!
content:
Sad News in Our Big Country

Hello, super kids! Today we have some news from our big country, South Africa. Sometimes, sad things happen that make grown-ups feel very worried and sad. Recently, some grown-up women have gone missing or have been hurt. This makes many people feel very sad and worried about their safety. One woman, her name was Dineo. She is one of the grown-up women we are thinking about. Her family and friends miss her very, very much. It’s hard when someone you love is not safe or is missing. It makes a whole lot of people feel like their hearts are a little bit broken. Did you know? South Africa is a very big and beautiful country! It’s at the bottom part of the map of Africa. We have amazing mountains, sunny beaches, and lots of special animals like lions, elephants, and even penguins in some places! It’s a country full of wonders. Many grown-ups are talking about these sad things because they care a lot. They want everyone to be safe and happy, especially all the women and girls. When grown-ups talk about sad news, it’s because they want to find ways to make things better and keep everyone out of harm’s way.

Who Are Our Helpers?

When sad things happen, it's wonderful to know that we have many helpers. Our police are like super helpers! They work very hard every day to find out what happened and to keep everyone safe. They wear special uniforms so you can easily see who they are. They are looking for answers and trying to make sure bad things don't happen again. Did you know? Police officers are trained to help people. If you ever get lost or feel unsafe, you can always look for a police officer. They are there to protect you! Many grown-ups in towns and villages are also helping the police. They form groups called 'community watches' or simply talk to each other to look out for everyone. They want their communities – that’s all the people who live close to each other – to be safe and happy places for everyone. When people work together, they are much stronger! Helpers also include teachers, parents, and even neighbours. Anyone who looks out for you and helps keep you safe is a helper! It’s like a big team working together.

Why Do We Need to Be Safe?

Every single person in the world, whether they are big or small, deserves to be safe. Safety means feeling happy and not scared. It means you can play outside, go to school, and sleep in your bed without any worries. When someone is hurt or not safe, it makes everyone feel sad and worried. That's why grown-ups are talking about this important topic. They want to make sure all women, all men, and especially all children, are safe in their homes and when they are outside playing. They want everyone to live a life full of joy and without worries. Did you know? In South Africa, we have many different languages! Like Zulu, Xhosa, Sotho, and Afrikaans. There are 11 official languages! But everyone understands a kind smile and a helping hand. Being safe also means feeling loved and respected. No one should ever feel scared or alone. Grown-ups are trying their best to create a world where everyone feels cared for and protected. They are finding ways to solve problems and make sure everyone is treated fairly.

What Can Kids Do?

You might be small, but you are very, very important! You have a powerful voice. If you ever feel scared, or if you see someone looking sad or hurt, it's super important to tell a trusted grown-up. This could be your mom, dad, gogo (grandma), mkhulu (grandpa), teacher, or any adult you trust. They will listen to you and help you. Did you know? Telling a grown-up when you are worried or feel unsafe is a very brave thing to do! It helps them know how to keep you and others safe. Your feelings matter a lot. It’s also important to know that if something bad happens, it is never, ever your fault. Always remember that grown-ups are there to protect you. If someone tells you to keep a secret that makes you feel yucky or scared, you should always tell a trusted adult. They will help you understand what to do. Playing safely is also important. Always tell your grown-up where you are going to play, and never go with strangers. These are little things that help keep you safe every day.

Being Kind and Strong Together

Even when sad things happen, it's important to remember that most people in the world are kind. They want to help and make things better. When communities work together, they become very strong. People are holding hands and helping each other in South Africa. They are sharing messages of love and saying that everyone deserves respect and care. Did you know? South Africa is famous for its beautiful flowers, especially the Protea! It’s our national flower and it’s very unique and strong, just like our people. When we are kind to each other, our world becomes a much happier and safer place for everyone. Being a good friend, sharing your toys, and using kind words are all ways to make our community stronger. Respect means treating everyone fairly, no matter how they look or where they come from. It’s like a big hug for everyone’s heart. Helpers are working to make sure everyone is safe, and that includes teaching everyone to be respectful and kind. When we all treat each other well, there is less sadness and more happiness.

Hoping for a Happy and Safe Future

All the grown-ups are working very hard so that everyone in South Africa can feel safe and happy. They want to make sure sad things like this don't happen again. We all hope for a future where everyone is safe, cared for, and treated with love and respect. This includes all the women, men, and especially you, the wonderful children! Did you know? Nelson Mandela, a very special leader from South Africa, taught us all about peace, fairness, and kindness. He worked hard so everyone could live together happily and safely. His lessons help us even today. Remember, you are loved and you deserve to be safe. Keep shining your bright lights, little ones! By being kind, telling grown-ups when you need help, and always hoping for good, we can all help make our big, beautiful South Africa an even safer and happier place for everyone to live and grow. Let’s all be helpers together! Every little bit of kindness makes a big difference.
summary: Grown-ups in South Africa are working hard to keep everyone, especially women, safe and happy because some women have recently gone missing or been hurt, making many people feel sad and worried.
whyMatters: This is important because everyone, big or small, deserves to feel safe and loved, and grown-ups are trying to make sure our communities are safe places for all.

originalTitle: Qatar PM urges Gulf security framework with Iran
title: Super News! Countries Want to Be Super Safe Neighbours!
content:
Hello, Super Friends!

Hello, hello, hello, amazing kids all across our wonderful continent of Africa! I'm your super friendly news reporter, bringing you exciting stories from near and far. Today, we're going on a special adventure to learn about countries being good neighbours. Imagine your very own street, where everyone plays nicely, shares their toys, and no one ever feels scared. That's a happy place, right? Well, grown-up leaders of countries want the same happiness and safety for all the people in their lands! It's like a big, important game of 'Let's all be friends!' We're talking about big countries acting like the best friends on the playground. They want to make sure everyone feels cozy and safe, just like you do in your own homes.

A Big Idea for Big Friends!

So, what's this exciting news all about? It comes from a country far away called Qatar. Qatar has a very important leader, just like your school has a head teacher, but for a whole country! This leader is called the Prime Minister. And the Prime Minister of Qatar has a super smart idea, an idea that makes us all smile! He wants all the countries that live near a special, big sea to make a promise to each other. He wants them to have a special 'plan' or 'framework' – that's just a fancy word for a good plan – to make sure everyone feels safe and happy. The main idea is that no country should ever make another country feel scared or worried. Isn't that a wonderful wish? It's like saying, 'Let's all play fair and be kind!' He believes that when countries have a clear plan, they can avoid misunderstandings and grow together like a big, happy family.

What's This "Gulf" Place?

Now, you might be wondering, 'Which big sea are we talking about?' This special big sea is called the 'Gulf.' Sometimes people call it the Persian Gulf. It's a very, very important part of our world because lots of countries are neighbours around its waters. Imagine a gigantic, beautiful lake, and many different homes are built all around its edges. Each home is a country! Some of these countries are Qatar, where our friendly Prime Minister lives, and another big country called Iran, and many more. They are all like neighbours living on the same street, sharing the same beautiful water. It's super important for all these neighbours to get along and be good to each other, just like you get along with your neighbours at home. When neighbours are friends, everyone feels better! This Gulf is a busy place, with lots of big ships sailing by, carrying goods and people, so peace there is super important for everyone.

Making a Special Promise

Let's talk more about this 'special plan' or 'framework.' What does it really mean? Think about it like this: When you play with your friends, sometimes you make rules, right? Like, 'We will take turns on the swing,' or 'We will share our crayons.' These rules help everyone have fun and stop arguments. Well, this special plan for countries is like making big, important rules for friendship and safety. It's a promise that all these countries living near the Gulf would make to each other. They would promise to talk about their problems instead of getting angry. They would promise to help each other grow strong and happy. It's a way of saying, 'We are all in this together, and we will look out for each other!' This kind of promise helps everyone feel peaceful and calm. It makes sure no country tries to upset another, just like you wouldn't try to upset your best friend.

Why Being Safe is Super Important!

The Prime Minister of Qatar said that the Gulf won't be the same unless this plan is in place. What he means is that if countries don't have this special promise, they might sometimes worry about each other. They might feel a little bit scared, just like if a friend isn't sharing and you worry you won't get a turn. But if everyone agrees to be friends and safe, then everything changes for the better! When countries feel safe, amazing things can happen. Children can go to school every day with big smiles. Families can build their homes and plant their gardens without any worries. People can travel and visit other countries and learn wonderful new things. Businesses can grow, and more jobs can be created. Peace is like a magic spell that makes everything better for everyone! It helps countries share food, medicines, and good ideas, making life better for all the children and grown-ups.

Did You Know? Fun Facts!

Let's sprinkle in some fun 'Did you know?' facts, just for you!
  • Did you know? The country of Qatar is a very small country but it has some of the tallest and most amazing buildings in the world! They also have a very hot desert where special animals like camels live.
  • Did you know? Iran is a country with a very long history, older than many stories you might read! They have beautiful patterns on carpets and old, old buildings called palaces where kings and queens used to live.
  • Did you know? The 'Gulf' sea is very important for boats and ships that carry oil and other goods all around the world! It's like a super busy highway for ships, bringing important things to many countries.
  • Did you know? Just like we play games to learn about sharing and kindness, countries sometimes have special meetings to talk about how to be better friends and neighbours! They sit down and talk, just like you might with your teachers.
  • Did you know? Peace is not just about stopping fights; it's about helping everyone to live happily, grow, and learn. It’s like when everyone in your class works together to make a beautiful drawing, making it even better!

Let's All Be Good Neighbours!

So, the big message from Qatar's Prime Minister is all about being good neighbours. It's about countries understanding each other, helping each other, and promising to always be kind. This way, everyone in the Gulf region can feel super safe and happy. It's a wonderful goal, isn't it? Just like you learn to share and be kind to your friends and family, countries are learning to do the same. Because when we all work together, whether we are kids playing in the playground or big countries living near a special sea, the world becomes a much brighter, happier, and safer place for everyone. Let's hope all the countries can make this special promise and be friends forever! Hurray for peace and friendship! Remember, even small acts of kindness can make a big difference, for people and for countries!
summary: The leader of Qatar wants countries near a big sea called the Gulf to make a special promise to be friends and keep everyone safe, so no one feels scared.
whyMatters: This is important because when countries are friends and feel safe, everyone can live happily, go to school, and build a brighter future without worries.
